name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for the Students of Notified Tribes and Denotified Tribes Castes
benefit: > **Scholarship Amounts:** - Boys (Class 1st to 8th): ₹750/- per annum- Boys (Class 9th to 10th): ₹1,000/- per annum- Girls (Class 1st to 5th): ₹500/- per annum- Girls (Class 6th to 10th): ₹1,000/- per annum
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must belong to Notified Tribes or Denotified Tribes as recognized by the Government of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be a student and studying in standard 1st to 10th. 1. The applicant must be studying in a government or government-aided primary or secondary school. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. There is no income limit for students from standard 1st to 8th. 1. The applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹6,00,000/- for classes 9th to 10th.
